description:
Most people think survival starts when disaster hits. We think it starts long before that — at your front door, in your driveway, in the five minutes before trouble finds you.

Prepper Defense breaks down real home defense tactics, overlooked warning signs, and practical preparedness steps that actually matter — not theory, not fear-mongering, just what keeps you and your family safe when it counts.

From spotting the habits that put your home at risk to knowing exactly what to do when things go wrong, every video is built to make you harder to catch off guard.

Stay sharp. Stay ready. Stay defended.

Subscribe and never be the easy target.
